# FLEX Logistics Saudi Arabia

> Dammam-based B2B logistics and supply chain services. This page is for factual discovery, not a guarantee of regulatory approval, site capacity or shipment availability.

- Website: https://scsflex.com/
- Company: FLEX Logistics Saudi Arabia (public trading description; exact legal-entity name to be verified before publishing)
- Headquarters: Dammam, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia
- Public sales email: info@scsflex.com
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/flexsupplychainservices

## Services
FLEX Logistics Saudi Arabia provides third-party warehousing, distribution, freight forwarding, transport and customs-clearance coordination for B2B customers. Enquiries may concern industrial products, chemicals, FMCG and other commercial cargo. Handling and storage eligibility depend on the commodity, location, paperwork, permits, equipment and safety requirements.

## Regional shipment planning
For cross-border road freight, share origin, destination, cargo, shipment size, ready date, importer details, planned crossing, customs documents and any hazardous-goods identification. FLEX can discuss requirements and plan a commercially appropriate service subject to current conditions.

## About dangerous goods and regulated cargo
Acceptance is conditional on an appropriate SDS, correct classification, package and warehouse/carrier compatibility, permits and applicable regulations. Do not assume any particular dangerous goods class, pharmaceutical capability or licence is approved without confirmation from FLEX operations.
